```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

source("ProjectPowell.R")

```
```{r Projection Calculation, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# Sets up slider inputs
sliderInput(
  "Release",
  label = "Scheduled Release from Powell (MAF/year)",
  min = 5,
  max = 10,
  value = 6,
  step = 0.25
)


sliderInput(
  "Additional_Release",
  label = "Additional Inflow to Powell (MAF/year)",
  min = .5,
  max = 5,
  value = 1,
  step = 0.25
)

sliderInput(
  "Add_Time",
  label = "Length of Additional Inflow",
  min = 6,
  max = 24,
  value = 12,
  step = 2
)


# Passes inputs through projection function
projection <- reactive({
  ProjectPowell(
    Inflow = "CRMMS",
    Release = input$Release,
    Add_Release = input$Additional_Release,
    Add_Time = input$Add_Time,
    Duration = 36,
    Storage_Data = hydrodata
  )
})

# plots projection
output$projectionplot <- renderPlot({
  fplotprojection(projection())
})
annual_inflow <- reactive({ fAnnualValues(projection(), "inflow") })


output$annualText <- renderPrint({
  ai <- annual_inflow()

  cat("Total Annual Inflow Volume (Including Additional Inflow):\n\n")

  cat(
    paste0(
      ai$year,
      " - ",
      round(ai$value / 1e6, 1),
      " MAF"
    ),
    sep = "\n")
  cat("\n")
  
  cat(paste0("Total Annual Outflow: ", input$Release, " MAF"))
  
})



```
```{r output, results = "show"}
plotOutput("projectionplot")
verbatimTextOutput("annualText")

```
